title: BUG: Double down arrows are back
symptom: AAPS shows double down arrows even when glucose is stable or rising, and the arrows can get stuck or appear intermittently. The issue occurs with Dexcom G6 sensors and xDrip, and has been observed across multiple versions.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a root cause. It is speculated that the issue may be related to sensor age, compression lows, or faulty readings, and that xDrip+ in native mode may not provide a trend arrow, causing AAPS to default to double down.
fix: No definitive fix is provided in the thread. Some users report the arrows stop by themselves. One user suggests that AAPS should calculate trend arrow internally when xDrip+ does not provide one, but no solution is confirmed.
evidence_quote: It seem to happen mostly after a compression low or faulty reading. xDrip+ in native mode (G6) then show no trend arrow. When this happens AAPS always show double down arrow. @MilosKozak what does AAPS do if xDrip+ doesn't provide trend arrrow? When smoothing BG data within AAPS, shouldn't AAPS calculate trend arrow also internally?
